title: Pull cloud ratings, comments and handles into the library
description: People rate and comment on the hosted site; those records stay in DynamoDB, so the library and local tools (apricity serve, analysis) never see them. Add scripts/pull-cloud.py: mirror prod Rating, Comment and Handle into ~/Apricity-Library/<Model>/<id>.json (only changed files rewritten; library copies of cloud records that no longer exist are removed; local records untouched). Local tallies are summed from Rating files, so local mode then shows everyone's ratings.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Landed: scripts/pull-cloud.py + apricity_analyze.cloud_pull, 3 tests. First run pulled 61 ratings and 1 handle; local server lists 169 ratings (108 local + 61 cloud).
